requirements.title: IMAGE_STATUS IMAGE and TEAM argument restrictions
requirements.definition: IMAGE shall be an integer whose value is positive and no greater than the number of images in the specified team; TEAM, when present, shall be scalar TEAM_TYPE representing the current or an ancestor team, and absent TEAM specifies the current team.

pending.IMAGE_STATUS-image-integer-positive-in-t: Use IMAGE_STATUS(1) in a single-image current team as the positive source plan; invalid image values are unnumbered argument-rule mutations with no diagnostic facet.
pending.IMAGE_STATUS-team-current-or-ancestor: OUT OF SCOPE: positive TEAM-object observations require team context beyond this suite's single-image fixture scope.
pending.IMAGE_STATUS-absent-team-current-team: Use IMAGE_STATUS(1) with TEAM absent in a single-image execution and observe the retained zero-status facet; mutate by adding a TEAM argument only in source-control review.

requirements.oracle: Source registration only. Coarray/image-dependent runtime fixtures are intentionally not planned for this suite: coarray, local-coarray, team, failed-image, and stopped-image observations are OUT OF SCOPE by user decision. The only retained executable IMAGE_STATUS plans use the current single image and observe default-integer kind or the zero otherwise status fixed by the Result Value text. No diagnostic, multi-image ordering, team-establishment, failed-image, or stopped-image coverage claim is created.
requirements.oracle_limitation: Source accounting only. This packet creates no Fortran fixture, compiler invocation, execution evidence, evidence link, fixture approval, oracle approval, or coverage claim. IMAGE_INDEX requires a coarray argument and team/cosubscript context, so every positive runtime observation is OUT OF SCOPE by user decision, including local single-image coarrays. IMAGE_STATUS facets concerning failed or stopped images are also OUT OF SCOPE; the catalogue keeps only the single-image current-image zero-status and default-integer characteristic plans that do not require coarrays. Unnumbered argument shalls are not diagnostic facets.

requirements.title: IMAGE_STATUS named constants for failed and stopped images
requirements.definition: The result is STAT_FAILED_IMAGE for a failed specified image and STAT_STOPPED_IMAGE for a specified image that has initiated normal termination.

pending.IMAGE_STATUS-stopped-image-status: OUT OF SCOPE: inducing or observing another image that has initiated normal termination is image-dependent and outside this single-image fixture suite by user decision.

Result Value paragraph is split between out-of-scope failed/stopped image states and the single-image zero-status effect.
Named-constant status values for failed and stopped images.
Zero status for all other specified images.
Example paragraph is illustrative and depends on a failed image.

review_rationale: Source registration for 16.9.106-16.9.112: IEOR, IMAGE_INDEX, IMAGE_STATUS, INDEX, INT, IOR and IPARITY (batch194). Every unit hash-verified by an independent reviewer across two rounds; IMAGE_INDEX and the team/failed/stopped facets of IMAGE_STATUS are out of scope; INDEX covers the zero-length-substring results; the numeric value of a BOZ with its leftmost bit set under INT has no portable oracle. Source accounting only.
